answer_1.quote: The process of using a pre‑translated text as a basis and improving it to create the final translation is called post‑editing (PE)… productivity gains of 36% when using modern neural MT for PE …

answer_4.quote: After each operation ... participants rated each modality for that operation on three 7‑point Likert scales ranging from "strongly disagree" to "strongly agree", namely as to whether the interaction "is a good match for its intended purpose", whether it "is easy to perform", and whether it "is a good alternative to the current mouse and keyboard approach".
answer_4.guideline: Participants evaluated modalities using 7‑point Likert scales on criteria of match, ease, and alternative to mouse/keyboard.
